Resolves #21366

A chip fills its pill in every theme, a glyph-less chip's text clears the pill's border, and the chip list takes its theme's frame instead of a near-white `#ddd`. This replaces the first version of this PR, a transparent rest surface (`889f26674b`), which the operator rejected on review: a chip needs a fill for contrast, above all inside a chip field. The ruling and the revised fix are in the #21366 body.

Intake: self-authored. Prescription checked: `resources/css/src/component/Chip.css` owns the chip's fill and text spacing, `resources/css/src/list/Chip.css` the item surface and the frame, and each theme's `component/Chip.css` the color.

Evidence: L3 (component specs in Chromium across four themes; headless crops of both examples on the dev server, before and after) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-5). Residual: AC-6, Residual-Owner: #21333.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/component/list/Chip.spec.mjs` › "ChipListComponent theme surfaces", one test each for `neo-theme-dark`, `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light`: the item's rest background equals `--chip-background-color` (resolved by a probe inside the item) and is not transparent, its radius equals the chip's, and the chip itself is clear. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same tests hover (the item's background changes) and click (the chip takes a fill). |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the spec's chips have no glyph, and their text sits at least 7 px inside the chip. Measured in the chip field example at head: 9 px. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the list's border equals a probe of `--list-container-border`. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered at head, 5 of 5. Outside-CI on `origin/dev`'s chip CSS: all 4 theme tests fail at the fill assertion (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)`). The list in each test carries its own theme class through its `theme` config, as a workbench example does. |
| AC-6 | Post-merge: the `form-field-chip` and `list-chip` tiles are recaptured on `dev` for neomjs/pages#109. |

## Deltas from ticket

None against the revised body. Against the first version: the rest surface is the chip's fill instead of transparent, and the item token is declared on the item. On the list it lost: in the workbench, the list element carries `neo-theme-light`, whose `:root .neo-theme-light` rule kept `--list-item-background-color` at `#fff` there.

Side effect: the 300 px chip field example now wraps its triggers onto a second row. On `dev` its first row is already full (the input sits at its 80 px minimum), and the 7.5 px text inset per glyph-less chip pushes it over. The triggers flowing like chips is the chip field's own layout: #21381.
